title: App crashes on startup after upgrade to 2.1
body: Since upgrading, launching the app immediately exits with a segfault. Steps: 1) install 2.1 2) run `app` 3) it crashes before the window appears. Logs attached.

title: Cart total is off by one cent on multi-item orders
body: When an order has 3+ items the displayed total is 0.01 less than the sum of line items. Expected the total to equal the sum; got a value one cent lower.

title: Add a dark mode theme
body: It would be great if the dashboard supported a dark theme that follows the OS setting. Not urgent, just a nice-to-have for night use.

title: Allow exporting the report as CSV
body: Please add a button to export the weekly report to CSV so we can open it in Excel. Today we can only view it in the browser.

title: Where does the config file live?

title: Login button unresponsive on Firefox
